tips.text: Aim Light Binding down the lane through the minion wave; it roots the first two enemies it hits, so line up a champion behind a minion.
Throw Lucent Singularity into a brush before you walk in; it shows the area and can reveal an ambush.
Place Lucent Singularity where the enemy wants to step or flee, then recast it to detonate once they are inside.
Follow a spell with a basic attack so Illumination goes off for extra damage before the mark fades.
Use Final Spark to finish a weakened enemy from far away; it also reveals everyone it hits and sets off Illumination.
Combine Lucent Singularity and Light Binding. Once the enemy is slowed by the zone, Light Binding is much easier to land.
Throw Prismatic Barrier so the wand passes through allies on its way out and back; each pass shields them, and you are shielded too.
Stay behind your minions and away from enemy skillshots; Lux has long range but little protection once caught.

combos.name: Singularity into Binding
combos.when: Poking or setting up a kill on an enemy who is walking toward you in lane.
combos.text: Throw the singularity first so its slow makes the Binding easier to land. Then pop the singularity once the enemy is rooted for extra damage.

tips.text: Aim Light Binding through minions at the enemy; it roots the first two enemies it hits, so line up a second target when you can.
Throw Prismatic Barrier so the wand passes through your support and ADC, then again on its return, to stack the shield on them.
Place Lucent Singularity on the path an enemy must take to engage or escape; it slows them while they stand in it.
Throw Lucent Singularity into a brush before you walk in; it shows the area and exposes ambushes.
After a spell hits, follow with a basic attack to pop Illumination for bonus damage before the mark fades.
Final Spark reaches very far, so use it to finish fleeing enemies or hit a whole group lined up in a fight.
Hold Light Binding for when the enemy commits to a move. Once they are rooted, follow up with Lucent Singularity so they cannot get away.

combos.name: Singularity into Light Binding
combos.when: Poking or catching an enemy in lane when you want the Q to land more reliably.
combos.text: Throw the singularity first so its slow makes the root easier to hit. Then fire the binding and recast to pop the singularity while they are rooted.

tips.text: Aim Light Binding down the lane so it can root two enemies in a line. Minions don't stop it, so fire through the wave at the enemy.
Throw Prismatic Barrier so it passes through your carry on the way out and again on the way back. Hitting them twice stacks a bigger shield.
Throw Lucent Singularity into a brush before you walk in to scout for ambushes.
Place Lucent Singularity on the enemy's path to slow them as they advance or run. Recast it to detonate when they are standing inside.
After you hit an enemy with a spell, follow with a basic attack. Illumination adds extra magic damage.
Use Final Spark from long range to finish low-health enemies or to join a fight from far away. Its beam also reveals the enemies it hits.
Follow a rooting Light Binding with Lucent Singularity and Final Spark. The enemy can't walk out of the damage.

combos.name: Slow, root, then detonate
combos.when: Trading or catching an enemy in lane when you want the root to land.
combos.text: Throw the singularity first so the slow makes the root easier to land. Recast it once the root hits, then use an attack to pop the passive.

combos.name: Wand return shield
combos.when: When an ally is close to you and you want to shield them, or you keep missing the outgoing throw.
combos.text: Throw the wand past your ally, or away from them, so the return trip passes through them. Passing through twice stacks the shield, up to two times.

tips.text: Stand behind minions when Ahri is in range. Charm stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in the way soaks it.
Throw Light Binding when Ahri walks up to farm. It roots her and sets up Lucent Singularity and your next attack.
Put Lucent Singularity where Ahri wants to stand. She stays slowed, so she can't poke freely or dash in easily.
When Ahri has used Spirit Rush, trade and push hard. She is much easier to catch with it down.
Final Spark can finish a low Ahri from very far away. Use it when she retreats with low health.
Aim Light Binding at Akali when she steps up to trade. A root there lets you punish her before she can escape.
Throw Lucent Singularity onto Akali's Twilight Shroud when she hides. The area spell hits her and shows where she is.
Keep Prismatic Barrier ready for when Akali dives in. The shield cuts her burst.
Stay at long range from Akali. Her Five Point Strike slows you only at its tip, so keep her at that edge.
Trade when Akali is low on energy. She can't chain her abilities then.
At level 6, back off or keep your shield up when Akali has Perfect Execution. Low health is easy for her to finish.
Aim Light Binding at Anivia when she walks up to last-hit or cast; it roots her so you can follow up.
Do not stand in a line with Flash Frost; sidestep it, because the detonation at the end stuns.
Trade when Rebirth is down; Anivia is much easier to punish then.
Keep Anivia's mana low by poking her with Lucent Singularity; her Glacial Storm is costly to keep up.

comboRefs.note: Singularity's slow helps land Binding on Anivia, who has no listed way to avoid being rooted.

tips.text: Keep Light Binding for when Aurora hops in or out; it roots her in place so your Lucent Singularity and Final Spark can land.
Aurora can't be hit while she is invisible after Across the Veil, but she must still come out. Stay back and aim Lucent Singularity where she will appear.
Light Binding is blocked by the first two enemies it hits, so keep minions out of the line or Aurora will dodge behind them.
Stay out of The Weirding's line and range. Use Prismatic Barrier to soak her trades when she walks up.
Don't fight inside the Between Worlds ring; she can hop across its edge, and you get slowed when you touch it. Wait for it to close.
Finish a low-health Aurora with Final Spark from far away. It has very long range and she may not see it coming.

comboRefs.note: Singularity's slow helps Light Binding hit Aurora, who has hops and slows to close the gap.

tips.text: Aim Light Binding at Cassiopeia when she walks up for a last hit. If she is rooted, follow with Lucent Singularity.
Keep minions out of the line of Light Binding, or it will hit them and not Cassiopeia.
Stay out of Cassiopeia's range when she has you poisoned; Twin Fang hurts a lot against a poisoned target.
Turn away from Cassiopeia as she casts Petrifying Gaze, so you are slowed and not stunned.
Throw Lucent Singularity on Cassiopeia's Miasma clouds; she is slowed in them and can't dash out.
Use Final Spark from far away to hit Cassiopeia while she is slowed or stunned.

comboRefs.note: Singularity's slow helps Binding land on Cassiopeia, who is approaching to land her poison.

tips.text: Hold Light Binding until Fizz commits to a dash; it roots him in place and gives you time to follow up with your other spells and attacks.
Fizz becomes untargetable during Playful / Trickster, so wait for him to land before you throw Light Binding or Lucent Singularity.
Put Lucent Singularity where Fizz would land, to slow him and cut down his chance of getting away.
Keep Prismatic Barrier ready for when Fizz jumps on you; the shield absorbs part of his burst.
Final Spark has very long range, so use it to finish a Fizz who is low on health and trying to escape.
Stay away from Fizz when Chum the Waters is ready. If the fish sticks to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts.

comboRefs.note: Fizz's Playful makes him untargetable, so Light Binding can miss, but the slow helps when he dashes in.

tips.text: Wait until Void Shift is gone, then hit Malzahar with Light Binding. It cannot root him while the shift is up.
Stay out of Call of the Void's range. Being silenced leaves you unable to cast.
Stay away from minions carrying Malefic Visions; when they die it jumps to you.
Use Final Spark from long range to hit Malzahar while his Void Shift is down. Its range is much longer than his.
Do not let Malzahar get close at level 6. Nether Grasp holds you in place, so keep distance from him.
Throw Lucent Singularity at the spot where Malzahar will stand to cast his spells. It slows him and zones him off.
Hit Orianna with Light Binding when she steps up to farm. It roots her so your next ability lands.
Orianna's Ball only affects the area around it. Find where it sits and stay away from it.
Place Lucent Singularity where Orianna wants to go. Detonate it when she is inside, so she is slowed and takes damage.
Stay away from Orianna's Ball when her ultimate is ready. Command: Shockwave pulls you in and stuns you, so keep distance from it.
Orianna's Command: Attack passes through minions and still hits you. Stand out of its line while you farm.
Use Final Spark from long range to punish Orianna when she is hurt or caught out of position.

comboRefs.note: Singularity's slow makes Light Binding easier to land on Orianna, who has no listed way to dodge it.

tips.text: Keep your distance from Ryze. He needs to be close to cast Rune Prison and Spell Flux, so poke him as he walks up.
Hit Ryze with Light Binding when he walks in to trade. It has long range and keeps him in your damage.
Place Lucent Singularity on the spot Ryze steps toward, so he is slowed and cannot close in easily.
Ryze hits harder when you are marked with Flux, so fight back before he builds it up with Spell Flux.
If Ryze starts Realm Warp, stun or root him with Light Binding to cancel the portal.
Aim Light Binding at Sylas when he is about to dash in; the root holds him in place so you can follow with Lucent Singularity.
Sylas has to get close to hurt you, so poke him from long range with Lucent Singularity and keep your distance.
Keep minions between you and Sylas. Light Binding roots only the first two enemies it hits, so line up shots with a clear path.
Sylas can steal Final Spark with Hijack. Stay out of his line when he has it, and don't expect a free ultimate.
Use Prismatic Barrier on yourself before Sylas trades. It gives a shield when thrown and again when it returns.
Finish a low-health Sylas with Final Spark, since Kingslayer heals him more the lower he gets.

comboRefs.note: Singularity's slow helps Binding land on Sylas, whose Abscond dash and Abduct can dodge or close in.

tips.text: Open with Light Binding when Twisted Fate walks up to last-hit. Once he is rooted, your follow-up spells land easily.
Stay away from Twisted Fate while his Gold Card is up. It stuns you, and then Wild Cards hits you for free.
Place Lucent Singularity where Twisted Fate wants to stand. He gets slowed and cannot easily walk up to hit you.
When Destiny is used, expect a gank or roam and ping your team. Back off if you are low on health.
Use Final Spark on Twisted Fate when he is slowed or rooted. It is a long, narrow beam and he can dodge it if he is free to move.

comboRefs.note: Slowing with the singularity first helps land Binding on Twisted Fate as he walks up to trade.

tips.text: Hold Light Binding for when Viktor steps up to use Siphon Power or Hextech Ray; a rooted Viktor eats your whole combo.
Stay out of Gravity Field. Walk out of it quickly or you get stunned.
Cast Lucent Singularity on Viktor's position to slow him and punish his steps forward. Recast it once he is inside.
Throw Prismatic Barrier before Viktor trades; the shield absorbs part of his Hextech Ray and Siphon Power damage.
Use Final Spark to finish him from far away when he is low; its range is long.
Do not fight inside Arcane Storm; it follows you and keeps hurting you. Walk out and make him recast it.
Aim Light Binding at Yasuo from a distance. Wind Wall will block it if he raises it in time, so throw it when the wall is on cooldown.
Final Spark is not blocked by Wind Wall, so use it to finish Yasuo when he thinks he is safe behind his wall.
Put Lucent Singularity where Yasuo wants to dash or stand. He is slowed and takes damage when it detonates.
Stay back and poke him with your abilities. Yasuo has to dash across the lane to reach you.
Do not throw Prismatic Barrier at Yasuo; it is a shield for allies. Use it on yourself when he walks up to trade.
Stay away from your own allies being knocked up near Yasuo; Last Breath lets him teleport onto them.
Land Light Binding on Yone from long range, then follow with Lucent Singularity while he is rooted.
Aim Light Binding at the minions in front of Yone as well. It stops at the first two enemies, so a minion can soak it up before it reaches him.
Throw Lucent Singularity at his feet when he walks up to trade. The slow makes it hard for him to reach you.
Keep Prismatic Barrier ready for when he walks up with Mortal Steel and Spirit Cleave. Cast it so the shield lands on you.
Hold Light Binding for when Yone dashes with Soul Unbound or Fate Sealed. Rooting him after he commits makes him easy to punish.
Use Final Spark to finish Yone from far away. Its range is huge, so he can't easily dodge it when he is hurt.
Keep Lucent Singularity ready for when Zed dashes in; it slows him and its detonation hurts, so he cannot easily chase or escape.
Throw Light Binding when Zed places a Living Shadow or lines up on you. Rooted, he cannot move.
Cast Prismatic Barrier on yourself before Zed's Death Mark lands. The shield soaks damage from his burst.
Zed becomes untargetable during Death Mark's dash, so do not waste Light Binding on that moment. Wait until he reappears.
Zed's shadows slash from a distance, so stay out of the area around his shadows, not just around Zed.
Poke Zed from long range with Lucent Singularity and Light Binding when he has no energy or his shadow is on cooldown.

comboRefs.note: Singularity's slow helps Binding land on Zed, whose shadow dashes can otherwise dodge it.

tips.text: Aim Light Binding at Ashe whenever she walks up to attack; being rooted leaves her an easy target for your follow-up.
Ashe has few defensive options, so stay near your jungler and look for ganks on her.
Keep minions between you and Ashe so her Volley arrows are absorbed before they reach you.
Stay out of sight of anything alone on the map when her Enchanted Crystal Arrow is ready; it can stun you from across the map.
Place Lucent Singularity where Ashe will stand to slow her, then detonate it for poke.

comboRefs.note: Slow from Lucent Singularity helps Light Binding hit Ashe, who has no listed dash or escape to dodge it.

tips.text: Aim Light Binding so it catches Caitlyn when she lines up behind minions. It roots the first two enemies, so a minion in front can use up a hit.
Caitlyn outranges you, so keep minions between you. Piltover Peacemaker deals less damage to every enemy after the first.
Watch the ground for Yordle Snap Trap before you walk forward. Throw Lucent Singularity ahead of you to see what is there.
Use Lucent Singularity to slow Caitlyn when she walks up for a last hit, then follow with Light Binding.
Put Prismatic Barrier on yourself and your support before a trade, as it shields on the way out and back.
Use Final Spark to finish a hurt Caitlyn from far away, because her net pushes her only a short way.
Aim Light Binding through minions at Ezreal. It roots the first two enemies hit, so line up a clear shot.
Ezreal is fragile, so punish him when Arcane Shift is on cooldown. He has no easy escape then.
Throw Lucent Singularity where Ezreal will walk to last-hit. It slows him and makes his Mystic Shot pokes harder to follow up.
Use Prismatic Barrier to shield yourself against Ezreal's pokes before you trade.
Keep minions between you and Ezreal, since Mystic Shot stops at the first enemy it hits.
Use Final Spark at long range to finish a hurt Ezreal, since it reaches far across the lane.

comboRefs.note: Singularity's slow makes Light Binding easier to land on Ezreal, who relies on skillshots.

tips.text: Land Light Binding on Jhin when he walks up to last-hit; it can hit him and a minion behind him, and it leaves him rooted for a trade.
Throw Lucent Singularity at Jhin's feet to slow him. It also lets you see the area, so use it to check bushes before you walk in.
Jhin's reload leaves him unable to attack. Step up and poke him with your spells during it.
Move sideways when Jhin aims Deadly Flourish. He has a long range, and it roots you only if you were recently hurt by him or his ally.
Use Prismatic Barrier to shield yourself and your support before a trade. Jhin's Deadly Flourish can't safely finish you off in that window.
Watch for Jhin's invisible Captive Audience traps. Do not chase him through bushes where he may have placed one.
Final Spark has huge range, so use it to finish a weakened Jhin who retreats. Jhin has no spell shield to stop it.

comboRefs.note: The slow from Lucent Singularity helps Light Binding land on Jhin, who has no listed escape or dash.

tips.text: Land Light Binding on Jinx, then follow with a Lucent Singularity and a basic attack to trade hard while she is rooted.
Jinx has few ways to escape once she is caught. Aim Light Binding at her when her Flame Chompers are on cooldown.
Throw Lucent Singularity at her feet when she walks up to last-hit; the slow makes it hard for her to step back out.
Stay out of the line of Zap! and keep minions between you and her, since Light Binding stops after the first two enemies it hits.
Use Prismatic Barrier on yourself and your support before she pokes with rockets.
Final Spark can finish a Jinx who has lost health in a trade, from far away.
Hit Kai'Sa with Light Binding when she steps up to trade; she is rooted and can't dodge your follow-up.
Use Lucent Singularity to slow Kai'Sa when she walks in, then recast it to detonate once she is inside.
Poke Kai'Sa from long range. She is weak when outranged, so don't walk into her range.
Watch for Kai'Sa's Killer Instinct after she gets Plasma on you; it shields her as she jumps in. Keep Light Binding ready to answer it.
Stay near your support and don't wander alone. Kai'Sa is good at picking off isolated targets.
Aim Light Binding at Miss Fortune when she walks up to last-hit. It roots her so you can follow up.
Put Lucent Singularity where Miss Fortune stands to farm. It slows her and cuts off her approach.
Hit Miss Fortune to cancel her Strut speed boost. She loses it whenever she takes damage.
Stay out of Double Up range, and do not stand behind your minions. The shot bounces to you.
Do not stand still in front of Bullet Time when Miss Fortune has it. Keep your distance, because it hurts a lot if you stay in the cone.
Throw Prismatic Barrier to shield yourself before a trade, and shield your support too when they are in line.
Hold Light Binding until Spell Shield is used or on cooldown. Then Sivir is easy to root and her trade falls apart.
Fake an advance, then back off. Sivir often wastes Spell Shield when you do.
Throw Lucent Singularity at her when she steps up to hit the wave. It slows her so she cannot dodge your follow-up.
Step out of the way of Boomerang Blade. If it hits you on the way out, stay clear of it on its way back.
Sivir pushes the wave quickly with Ricochet. Clear it with your own spells so your tower is not under pressure.
Use Final Spark to finish Sivir after a root. It cannot be blocked by Spell Shield if she is already rooted and using it.
Hit Smolder with Light Binding early, then follow with your attack. He is weak in the early game and cannot easily get away while rooted.
Put Lucent Singularity where Smolder wants to stand to last-hit. It slows him and lets you poke him safely.
Punish Smolder while his stacks are low and he is weak. Get kills or force him back before he turns into a late-game dragon.
Use Final Spark to finish Smolder when he is low and tries to flee. Its range is very long.

comboRefs.note: The singularity's slow helps land the root on Smolder, who has no listed escape besides a short flight.

tips.text: Hit Yunara with Light Binding when she steps up to attack; she is rooted and cannot dodge your follow-up.
Aim Light Binding at the minion line in front of her too; it hits the first two enemies, so a minion in the way can soak it.
Drop Lucent Singularity where Yunara wants to stand to farm; it slows her and blocks her approach.
Do not rely on a slow to catch Yunara once she powers up with her ultimate; she can dash away. Save Final Spark for after the dash.
Use Prismatic Barrier on yourself before she throws her prayer bead, so its damage over time hurts less.
Keep Light Binding for when Alistar walks up to Headbutt. Rooting him there stops him from reaching you.
Stay far from Alistar, because Headbutt has a long range and he follows it with Pulverize. Lucent Singularity keeps him slowed while you step back.
Do not fight Alistar while Unbreakable Will is active. Wait for it to wear off, then use Final Spark.
Move away from Alistar when Trample is running, because a full set of stacks makes his next attack stun you.

comboRefs.note: Lucent Singularity's slow helps Light Binding root Alistar, who is slow to close the gap himself.

tips.text: Land Light Binding on Anivia, then follow with Lucent Singularity and an attack. She is easy to kill when she is rooted.
Dodge Flash Frost by moving sideways, and stay out of its range when you can. Its blast stuns if you stay in its path.
Do not stay in Glacial Storm. It slows you and hurts more once it has fully formed, so step out.
Keep Prismatic Barrier ready for when Frostbite follows a Flash Frost hit. The shield soaks up that burst.
Once her egg appears, try to finish it. A Final Spark can help kill it before she is reborn.

comboRefs.note: Lucent Singularity's slow helps Light Binding root Anivia, who is slowed and stays in place.

tips.text: Aim Light Binding down the line of the lane so it roots both Bard and his carry; one root is enough to start a trade.
Stay out of a straight line with Bard. Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a second enemy or a wall, so stand away from walls and minions' lines.
Drop Lucent Singularity on his shrines or portal exit to slow him and keep him from chasing.
Throw Prismatic Barrier through your ally before Bard's stun comes, so the shield absorbs part of the damage.
Walk over Bard's Caretaker's Shrine to destroy it, so his ally can't take the heal.
Final Spark reaches very far, so use it to finish a Bard who is low and retreating.
Keep minions between you and Blitzcrank. Rocket Grab only pulls the first enemy it hits.
Use Light Binding on Blitzcrank as he walks up, since he has to come close. It roots him and stops his grab.
Place Lucent Singularity in front of him to slow his approach, and detonate it when he runs into it.
Stay at long range and poke with Lucent Singularity. Blitzcrank's grab has a shorter reach than your range.
Watch for Blitzcrank to wind up Static Field in a fight; it destroys your Prismatic Barrier shield, so don't count on it.
Dodge Brand's first spell, Sear or Pillar of Flame. Without it his combo cannot begin and he cannot stun you.
Light Binding roots Brand and any minion in its path. Fire it when he steps up to cast, and follow with Lucent Singularity.
Do not stand near minions or your ally. Conflagration spreads from them to you and sets you ablaze.
Step away from your ally when Pyroclasm is cast. Its first missile is slow, so you can react.
Final Spark has very long range. Use it to finish Brand from far away once your attacks and spells have marked him.
Aim Light Binding past Braum's raised shield, or wait until Unbreakable is down; the shield destroys the ball when it faces you.
Light Binding hits the first two enemies, so line it up through Braum and his carry. Braum soaking one still lets it reach the second.
Stay out of Winter's Bite range, because it slows you and starts the stack on you for Braum's stun.
Use Lucent Singularity to slow Braum and his carry when they step up, then hit the detonation for damage.
Take a step to the side when Braum starts Glacial Fissure. The long cast time gives you room to dodge, and the frozen ground slows you.
Aim Light Binding at Camille when she dives in with Hookshot; a rooted Camille is easy to burst and cannot jump again.
Place Lucent Singularity where Camille wants to stand or trade; the slow makes it hard for her to reach you.
Stay away from walls. Camille needs terrain to hook onto, so stand where she has none close by.
Move to the side when you see Camille's Tactical Sweep start; it takes a moment to land and the outer edge slows you.
Keep Prismatic Barrier ready for when Camille jumps on your carry; it shields you both against her burst.
Use Final Spark to finish Camille after she is stuck in place, or to hit her from far away while she retreats.
Aim Light Binding at Janna when she walks up for a Zephyr; she has no dash to dodge it, so it often roots her.
Do not stand close to Janna when her Monsoon is ready; it knocks you back and ruins your combo.
Stay away from where Janna can charge Howling Gale, and move sideways to dodge its knock up.
Harass Janna's ADC to weaken her; her Eye of the Storm shield soaks Lucent Singularity, so hit them before it is up.
Aim Light Binding when Karma walks up to poke. If a minion stands in front, it takes the hit first.
Stay out of Focused Resolve range, or break the tether by moving far away. If it holds, you get rooted.
Move away from the burning circle Karma leaves when Mantra boosts Inner Flame. It slows you and then deals heavy damage.
Karma's hits shorten Mantra's wait, so avoid easy trades. Use Lucent Singularity to push her back from your side of the lane.
Light Binding Leona as she walks up; the root gives you time to back away. Aim it so a minion does not absorb it.
Keep Light Binding ready for her engage. If you land it, you can usually trade before she stuns you.
Put Lucent Singularity where Leona will come from; the slow makes her dash in less safely.
Stay far back from Leona; Zenith Blade has long range. Stand behind minions so it is harder for her to reach you.
When Leona raises Eclipse, back away and do not trade into her; her resistances are high while it lasts.
Step out of the center of Solar Flare to avoid the stun; it is only a slow at the edge.
Stay out of Glitterlance range and poke with Lucent Singularity first; it is long range and slows Lulu if she steps in.
Aim Light Binding at Lulu when she walks up to cast; it roots the first two enemies it hits, so a squishy partner behind her gets caught too.
Do not let Whimsy catch you; Lulu can turn you into a critter and you cannot fight back. Keep minions or distance between you.
Use Prismatic Barrier on your carry before Lulu's poke lands; the shield also covers you on the way out and back.
Fire Final Spark when Lulu's team commits with Wild Growth; the beam is long range and hits everyone in the line.
Keep Light Binding for when Maokai commits with Twisted Advance, or when he walks up to an ally. He is a big, easy target.
Don't spend spells on Maokai without a reason. Each spell that hits him shortens the cooldown on Sap Magic, his self-heal.
Don't cast at Maokai during Twisted Advance. He can't be targeted while he dashes.
Stay out of brush Maokai could be watching, and don't walk near a Sapling. It chases you and slows you, and in brush it hurts more.
Keep your distance from Maokai. If he gets close, Bramble Smash knocks you back and slows you.
Use Final Spark to hit Maokai and his ally together from far away. It passes through everyone in its line.
Hold Light Binding until Mel has used Rebuttal; her nova destroys the ball, so throw it right after it goes off.
Lucent Singularity is also blocked by Rebuttal, so bait the nova first. Then slow her where she wants to step.
Final Spark is not blocked by projectile-destroying effects, so Mel's Rebuttal cannot stop it. Use it to finish a low-health enemy.
Stay out of Solar Snare's long range. Its root lasts longer the farther it flies, so keep minions or the wall between you and Mel.
Do not trade when Mel's basic attack is loaded with bolts from her spells. Wait for her to spend them, then poke back.
Shield yourself with Prismatic Barrier before you walk into her range, to blunt her poke.

comboRefs.note: Lux's wand return shield can help absorb Mel's poke when an ally is close.

tips.text: Aim Light Binding at Milio when he steps up to cast; it roots the first two enemies, so he and his carry can both get caught.
Hold Final Spark until he has used Breath of Life or you can kill him. Its long range lets you finish from far away.
Throw Lucent Singularity where Milio and his carry will stand. It slows them and cuts off their approach.
Stay out of a straight line with Milio. Ultra Mega Fire Kick is a line shot, and if it hits you it knocks you back and slows you.
Keep a minion between you and Morgana so Dark Binding hits it first; it stops at the first enemy it touches.
Use Light Binding on Morgana when her Black Shield is down; the shield would otherwise block the root.
Break Black Shield with Lucent Singularity's burst damage before you try to lock Morgana down, since it absorbs magic damage.
Leave the Tormented Shadow area quickly when you are low on health; it hurts more the lower you are.
Stay out of reach when Morgana starts Soul Shackles; get away from the chains before they finish and you avoid the stun.
Aim Light Binding at the enemy lane when they step up to hit minions. It roots up to two enemies, so it can catch Nami and her partner together.
Stay out of Aqua Prison range and keep minions or your partner between you and Nami. If she misses it, step in and trade.
Drop Lucent Singularity where Nami will stand to cast, then recast it to detonate. The slow makes her bubble and escapes harder.
Throw Prismatic Barrier through your partner on the way out and let it return to you. Shield yourself before Nami's bubble lands to soften the trade.
Walk away from a fight when the enemy carry has Tidecaller's Blessing. It runs out quickly, so wait before you trade.
Final Spark has very long range and her Tidal Wave is slow. Use it to finish a hurt Nami or enemy who is running away.
Stay behind your minions and your ADC. Nautilus needs a clear line for Dredge Line, and his anchor stops on the first enemy it hits.
Hit Nautilus with Light Binding when he walks up to the wave. He cannot move or attack while his anchor is in flight, so punish him if he misses.
Use Lucent Singularity to slow Nautilus when he closes in, and set it in the brush first to check for him.
Throw Prismatic Barrier through your ADC when you expect a Nautilus engage. The shield also protects you on the way back.
Do not stand next to him for a basic attack. Staggering Blow roots you, and then his allies can follow up.
Use Final Spark to finish Nautilus when he is low after a failed engage. It reaches very far, so you can fire from safety.

comboRefs.note: The slow-then-root setup helps Light Binding land and catch Nautilus, who wants to close the gap.

tips.text: Aim Light Binding at Neeko when she walks up to a minion; it roots the first two enemies hit, so keep it clear of other targets.
Keep Lucent Singularity ready to slow Neeko when she dives in, and throw it into brush to check for ambushes.
Stay out of Tangle-Barbs range and don't stand behind minions, because the tangle grows stronger after it hits one enemy and roots you for longer.
Cast Prismatic Barrier on yourself and your ally before Neeko's level 6 stun-and-knock-up combo, since the shield absorbs part of the damage.
Be wary of allies that look odd or stand still, since Neeko can hide with Inherent Glamour. Throw Lucent Singularity to reveal the area first.
Aim Light Binding at Pantheon before he gets close. Rooting him stops his jump-in, and it is your best answer to his dive.
Do not fire at Pantheon while he is bracing with Aegis Assault, since he blocks damage from the front. Wait for it to end or hit him from the side.
Keep your health up, because Pantheon's hurled Comet Spear hits much harder against low-health targets.
Put Lucent Singularity where Pantheon will jump or walk in. The slow makes him easier to hit.
Watch for Pantheon's Mortal Will counter, because his next spell is stronger once it is full. Stay back until it is spent.
Pantheon's Grand Starfall gives a warning before he lands. Use it to move away, then punish him with Final Spark.
Aim Light Binding at Poppy as she walks up; being rooted keeps her from reaching you. Then follow up with Lucent Singularity.
Stay away from walls behind you, because Heroic Charge into terrain stuns you.
Don't dash near Poppy while Steadfast Presence is up; it stops the dash and hurts you.
Step onto Poppy's dropped buckler to destroy it and deny her the shield.
When Poppy starts spinning her hammer for Keeper's Verdict, move sideways out of its line.
Use Prismatic Barrier on your lane partner before trades to blunt Poppy's burst.

comboRefs.note: Slowing with Lucent Singularity first makes Light Binding easier to land on Poppy before the detonation.

tips.text: Hit Pyke with Light Binding when he charges Bone Skewer; he stands still-ish and is rooted long enough for your team to punish him.
Place Lucent Singularity in bushes and on your lane before you step up; it reveals the area and slows Pyke if he tries to hide or dive in.
Keep your distance from Pyke. Stay behind your minions so Phantom Undertow and Bone Skewer have trouble reaching you.
Hold Prismatic Barrier for when Pyke starts to engage; the shield blunts his burst and you can pass it over your carry too.
Use Final Spark to finish a Pyke who is low and escaping; it has very long range and he cannot regain health while you see him.
Pyke regains health when hidden, so Final Spark reveals him and Lucent Singularity keeps vision, so use them to stop his Ghostwater Dive heal.

comboRefs.note: Slowing with Lucent Singularity before Light Binding helps root Pyke before he can hook or dash in.

tips.text: Throw Light Binding at Rakan when he lands from Grand Entrance; he is easy to hit while he waits for the knock up. Rooted, he cannot dash away.
Aim Light Binding at Rakan when he is alone, since his dashes need an ally to reach. It can hit two enemies, so line up both lane opponents.
Put Lucent Singularity on the spot where Rakan wants to land. It slows him and lets you detonate when he is stuck in it.
Use Prismatic Barrier on your ally before Rakan's Gleaming Quill trades. Shield your carry as the wand passes through and returns.
Respect The Quickness at level 6; it charms anyone he touches. Stay back from him, and keep Light Binding ready to stop his run.
Keep your distance from Rell. Light Binding has long range, so root her from afar before she can reach you.
Shattering Strike destroys shields, so Prismatic Barrier will not save you from her stun. Stay out of her lance range instead.
Put Lucent Singularity on the spot where Rell wants to land. Slowed, she has a harder time closing the gap.
Do not stand clumped with your carry when Rell is near. Ferromancy: Crash Down knocks up everyone it lands on.
Hold Light Binding for when Rell leaps in or mounts up to charge. Rooting her mid-engage stops her from reaching you.
Throw Lucent Singularity onto Senna when she walks up to attack; she gets slowed, so she cannot easily step out of your Light Binding.
Stay out of Senna's long attack range. She outranges you more as she collects souls, so do not stand in front of her.
Aim Light Binding along the lane so it roots both Senna and her carry; it passes through the first enemy to hit a second.
Use Final Spark to finish Senna when she is low; its range is long and it hits everything in a line.
Use Prismatic Barrier on yourself and your carry before Senna's Last Embrace lands, since her root sets up follow-up damage.
Throw Lucent Singularity at Seraphine when she steps up to poke; she is slowed and has to back off or take the burst when it detonates.
Hit Seraphine with Light Binding when she uses an ability and is caught still. Rooted, she cannot walk out of your follow-up.
Stay out of a straight line with Seraphine, because Beat Drop is a straight line. Standing behind a minion does not stop it.
Do not walk into Lucent Singularity's slow before her Beat Drop is ready. A slowed Lux gets rooted by it.
Use Prismatic Barrier on yourself and your ally before a trade. It blunts Seraphine's poke.
Once Seraphine is low, finish her with Final Spark from far away. It has very long range.

comboRefs.note: Seraphine has no listed escape or dodge, so the slow-then-root setup is hard for her to avoid.

tips.text: Aim Light Binding at Shen when he dashes at you; he is easy to hit in a straight line and rooted he cannot keep chasing.
Stay back from Shen's dash range. If he misses Shadow Dash, punish him with Lucent Singularity and your poke.
Do not rely on basic attacks to finish a trade when Spirit's Refuge is down; it blocks them. Wait for it to end first.
Watch for Shen's ultimate after level 6; shield your low-health ally with Prismatic Barrier before he lands beside them.
Aim Light Binding at Sona when she walks up to use her abilities. If she is rooted, your team can burst her down.
Kill Sona first when you can. She heals and shields her team and has little to protect herself with.
Place Lucent Singularity where Sona stands to poke, and detonate it when she walks into it.
Move out of range before Sona's empowered attack lands. It can slow you or reduce your damage, depending on her last ability.
Stay out of Crescendo's line, and do not group up with your ADC. One stun can lose you the fight.
Throw Prismatic Barrier to shield yourself and your ally just before Sona's poke lands, and again on its return.
Dodge Soraka's Starcall; hits heal her and slow you. Stand a little back so it is harder to land.
Aim Light Binding at Soraka when she walks up to heal; she has no dash, so being rooted leaves her open.
Stay out of Equinox. Its silence stops your spells, and the root comes when it ends.
Trade right after Soraka uses Equinox; it has a long cooldown, so you can poke her more safely.

comboRefs.note: The slow-then-root setup helps catch Soraka in lane, so she can't easily dodge or escape the trade.

tips.text: Hit Swain with Light Binding when he walks up to poke or last-hit. Then follow with your basic attack for extra damage.
Stay away from the range of Nevermove. It roots you and lets Swain pull you in, so keep minions between you.
Move around when you see Vision of Empire appear. It explodes after a short delay, so step out of the circle.
Throw Lucent Singularity at Swain's path to slow him and keep him away from your carry.
Do not stand near Swain once he uses Demonic Ascension. Back away; he is easy to escape, and you can slow him down.
Use Prismatic Barrier on yourself and your ally before a trade with Swain's Death's Hand.

comboRefs.note: Lux's slow-then-root lands the root to catch Swain, who has no listed dash to escape the lane trade.

tips.text: Aim Light Binding at Tahm Kench when he walks up for Tongue Lash; if it lands, he is rooted and you can back off or trade freely.
Stay out of Tongue Lash range, and watch his stacks. At three stacks his next Tongue Lash stuns, so give up the trade before then.
Use Prismatic Barrier on your carry and yourself before he can hit you, since his damage comes in short bursts.
Hit Tahm Kench with spells to chip his health. Lucent Singularity slows him, which makes it hard for him to reach you or to run away.
When Tahm Kench starts channeling Abyssal Dive, step away from the landing spot, because it knocks up everyone nearby.
Keep damaging him with Final Spark if he stays on the same line. It also reveals him, so use it after he has used his shield or Thick Skin.
Poke Taric with Lucent Singularity when he walks up to the wave. Making him approach gives him no free Bravado attacks.
Stay out of Dazzle's line and keep moving once you see Taric wind up. It bursts late, so you can step out of it.
Land Light Binding on Taric when he walks up. He is rooted and you can safely follow with your attack to set off Illumination.
Hold Final Spark if Taric is about to use Cosmic Radiance. Enemies cannot be hurt during the invulnerable window, so wait it out.
Stay behind your minions and keep your distance; if Thresh lands Death Sentence you are stunned and dragged to him.
Watch for Thresh starting to throw his scythe; the cast takes a moment, so step sideways as soon as you see it.
Use Light Binding on Thresh or his partner when they step forward. It has long range and roots them.
Throw Lucent Singularity where Thresh will walk, to slow him and make his hook harder to line up.
Use Prismatic Barrier on your carry and yourself before Thresh trades, so his poke and Flay hit shields first.
Do not stand next to Thresh when he has Flay ready; it can pull or push you into his team's range.
Aim Final Spark at anyone trapped inside The Box; they cannot easily leave. Its long range lets you fire from safety.
Aim Light Binding at Vel'Koz when he steps up to poke; he has little mobility, so a rooted Vel'Koz is easy to follow up on.
Hold Final Spark for when Vel'Koz channels his ray; the beam is long enough to hit him from far away while he stands still.
Throw Lucent Singularity where Vel'Koz stands to poke him and slow him. Setting it down also gives sight of the area, so you can check the brush.
Step out of the line of Plasma Fission. It splits after it hits something, so stay clear of the sides too, and don't stand behind your minions.
Use Prismatic Barrier on yourself and your ally before trades to soak his Void Rift and Plasma Fission damage.

comboRefs.note: The singularity slow helps land Light Binding on Vel'Koz, who is slow to dodge and has no escape listed.

tips.text: Stay out of Shocking Orb's line. Keep a minion between you and Xerath, because the orb stops on the first enemy it hits.
Throw Light Binding when Xerath stands still charging Arcanopulse; he is slowed and easier to hit.
Once Light Binding roots Xerath, follow with Lucent Singularity and an attack to pop Illumination.
Walk out of the circle when Eye of Destruction lands; the center slows far more than the edge.
Use Final Spark to finish Xerath from long range when he is low, or to punish him mid Rite of the Arcane.
Yuumi is untargetable while attached, so aim Light Binding and Lucent Singularity at her ally; she can only be hit while she is detached.
Light Binding stops at the first two enemies, so line it up to root both the enemy carry and Yuumi when she has detached.
Go after Yuumi right after she detaches or gets stunned or rooted, because she cannot re-attach while immobilized.
Use Final Spark on the pair in a fight; it goes a long way and hits everyone in the line.
Dodge Prowling Projectile by stepping sideways; it is thin and slow at first, and it stops at the first enemy it hits.
Zilean is hard to kill but fragile if you focus him. Root him with Light Binding when he walks up for a bomb, then burst him with your ally.
Move after you cast when Time Bomb sticks to you. If a second bomb lands, the first one goes off and you are stunned.
Put Lucent Singularity where Zilean wants to stand or flee. He is slowed inside it, so it is hard for him to get away from your allies.
Wait for Chronoshift to run out before you finish off a target. Final Spark kills nothing while they are in Stasis.
Use Prismatic Barrier on yourself and your ally when Zilean starts trading, so his bombs hurt less.
Stay out of Grasping Roots range. Zyra's vines are a straight line, so keep your distance and step sideways when she aims at you.
Aim Light Binding at Zyra when she steps up to plant seeds. It roots the first two enemies hit, so it can catch both Zyra and her partner.
Throw Lucent Singularity onto her seeds and plants. It slows anyone near them and gives you sight of the area.
Zyra's plants have a short range. Poke her from outside it, then use Prismatic Barrier on you and your partner to absorb her return poke.
Final Spark reaches very far. Use it to finish Zyra after she is rooted or slowed, or when she is caught on low health.

comboRefs.note: The slow and root let Lux catch Zyra, who has no listed dash, and her plants can't dodge it.
